summary.text: Paul Bauer is a Nonpartisan candidate for Alaska House of Representatives District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Andrew Gray (D).
He is a U.S. Army veteran and a former member of the Anchorage Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Bauer was born in Brooklyn, New York, and served in the U.S. Army from 1973 to 1995.
He earned a degree from Siena College in 1990 and an associate degree from the University of Alaska Anchorage in 1997.
His career includes work as a contract employment education facilitator with the U.S. Department of Labor and as a manager with the Alaska Military Youth Academy.

Bauer served on the Anchorage Assembly and as a mayor's commissioner on the Public Facilities Advisory Commission, and has been a director of the Alaska Moose Federation and the Alaska Military History Museum Board.
He was a candidate in the 2015 Anchorage mayoral election, ran in 2020 as a Republican for Alaska House District 16, and ran for District 20 in 2022.
